statement: The fish lead: the plain fish G220 is immediately preceded by a numeral more often than its inside-marked forms (G231, G233, G244: every G220 variant with inside marks only in the blind annotation). Reading: the plain fish is a counted item; an inside mark makes it something that is not counted. Exploration: 37% (67/181) vs 12% (17/147), difference +0.25, p 0.0002 (results/inside_function_scouting.md, check run 23 October 2026 on exploration only). Neighbour test, so incomplete texts are kept; identical texts deduplicated. Data: the held-out-from-export set (data/icit_merged_paragorth/new_to_export_corpus.csv; ICIT objects absent from this project's export, never used in any analysis here; not independent of ICIT). Registered before the set was analysed (protocol: predictions/newset_protocol_2026-10-23.md). One run. BH within the new-set batch.
